sources.finding: Vulkan compatibility gate defaults off with runtime PSO precaching; -psocache cannot override GRHISupportsPipelineFileCache.
The -logpso flag deletes the existing writable user cache. User cache filename includes SF_VULKAN_SM6. Logging CVars can preserve the seed.
Runtime creation counter excludes initializers with bFromPSOFileCache or bPSOPrecache. Zero does not imply no Vulkan creation work.

Vulkan emits at >1ms; analysis filters >20ms. Graphics outer duration contains key-CS duration; count outer only. Compute duration includes CreateComputePipeline and its shared GlobalPSOCache acquisition. Completion callback saves cache then acquires GlobalPSOCache exclusively and merges.
CVar SaveBoundPSOLog permits user-cache loading. Precompile completion log precedes completion delegate; it does not measure the complete Vulkan callback duration.
DPCVars startup overrides apply readonly compatibility/logging settings without project config mutation.
Native Dump commandlet reads descriptions and precache classifications from the exact recording.
